family.description: Confirmatory comparison of the matched-algorithm LDPC decoder cells: gf2-coding against AFF3CT v4.7.0, both f32 flooding normalized min-sum at factor 0.75, iteration cap 50 and syndrome stopping, on bit-identical parity-check matrices and bit-identical recorded LLRs. It estimates comparator gaps under frozen decision margins and makes no adoption decision. Each call includes decoder construction, conversion, output and destruction. The identical timed batch is processed by both arms; latency is per batch, and throughput is frames per batch divided by batch time. Prepared 128-frame quality evidence is reused without resampling. Warm timing uses fixed fixture bank zero: the first recorded frame for matched latency and the first sixteen recorded frames for quality-compatible batch throughput. The remaining recorded frames supply quality validation, not additional timed samples. Both arms load the same recorded AList and construct their native sparse matrix and decoder inside each call; no encoder is initialized. This is recorded-AList operation version 1; prior fixture-constructor attempts are excluded from this family's resolution evidence. Protocol v3 retains the frozen corpus, operation and quality tolerance; its independent-frame BER and paired FER rules determine quality admission. All declared candidates remain visible when non-inferiority is unestablished. Prior v1 receipts are immutable superseded evidence and supply no v3 resolution. Exact upstream revisions, actual compiler/backend observations and executable identities are pinned by dev/bench_results/c077a88b/v3-preparation/build-identity.json (SHA-256 8f42c2afbea96b763117335d3daab9c415bc84bfebe28272457bc82b65a56eea). The receipt snapshots this record and the complete producing-input closure.

effect.rationale: This family reports a comparator gap and adopts nothing, so it declares no worthwhile speedup; the material-gap threshold below is the margin it decides on.
effect.equivalence_rationale: Twice the pilot-observed measurement resolution of 0.030. A comparator within that factor of the gf2 decoder is not a gap this host can resolve, so the family declares it equivalent rather than reading a difference the harness cannot see.
effect.material_gap_rationale: Four times the pilot-observed measurement resolution of 0.030, and outside the equivalence margin. A comparator faster than that on a whole-consumer decode is a gap a consumer would notice on a real frame budget and one that needs an attributed explanation rather than a note.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: A survey adopts nothing into production, so it budgets no new unsafe kernel and no production source.
